# Al Haya Sofa Care UAE

> Al Haya Sofa Care UAE is a professional sofa, couch and upholstery cleaning company serving Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi. We provide at-home deep shampoo cleaning, steam sanitization, stain removal, leather care and pet-hair removal — same-day service, eco-friendly products, fast drying (2–4 hours). Booking via phone/WhatsApp: +971 54 719 9189.

## Frequently asked questions
- How much does sofa cleaning cost in Dubai? Sofa cleaning starts from AED 39 (pet-hair removal), AED 79 (shampooing), AED 89 (steam cleaning) and AED 99 (deep cleaning); leather from AED 129. Prices include at-home doorstep service.
- Do you offer same-day sofa cleaning? Yes — same-day at-home service across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman and Abu Dhabi. Book on WhatsApp +971 54 719 9189.
- How long does a sofa take to dry? Most sofas are 90% dry and usable within 2–4 hours thanks to high-suction extraction.
- Do I need to move my sofa? No — the team brings all equipment and cleans the sofa at your home.
- Are the products safe for kids and pets? Yes — all products are eco-friendly, non-toxic and pH-balanced.
- What is the difference between shampoo and steam cleaning? Shampoo (foam) lifts oils, grease and dirt for general deep cleaning; steam uses high-temperature vapor to sanitize and kill 99.9% of bacteria and dust mites. Both can be combined for the best result.
- Do you clean leather, velvet and microfiber? Yes — specialist pH-safe leather conditioning and low-moisture methods for velvet and microfiber.
